assertions.assert: With no `database` `<param>` (null) it reconciles to nothing: it runs no routine and sends its parent nothing; it is long-lived and never reaches a final state.

With a database it recalls the ACTIVE persistent `bot_behavior` rows through the Memory ability (which brings the database to the head revision); an empty inventory runs no routine and sends its parent nothing (the Memory ability's answers stay with the routines).
`bot.ability.routines.reconcile` `{}` reads the inventory again, any number of times, back to back (a reconcile while reconciling re-enters it); it answers the parent nothing.
A recall that fails (a database the Memory ability refuses) is logged `bot.ability.routines.reconcile.failed` and keeps the running set; nothing reaches the parent and later reconciles still work.
A reconcile whose data its schema rejects (any field: it carries no data) is `error.execution` in its sender and never reaches the routines.
